name: Chrono Bloom Spire
description: A spiraling tower where each level blooms in a different historical era, flowers aging and re‑blooming in seconds.
prompt: A towering spire composed of concentric terraces, each terrace a garden representing a distinct historical epoch: ancient Egyptian lotus, medieval roses, Victorian orchids, cyberpunk neon flora. Flowers bloom, wither, and rebloom in rapid time‑lapse visible as a single moment. Hyper‑realistic, cinematic lighting, 8k.
caption: Time blossoms on every floor. ⏳🌸
